local_patches.reason: Security: require the API token on every bind including loopback, validate Host/Origin against node.allowed_hosts (DNS-rebinding defence), remove node identity from the unauthenticated health probe, disable generated API docs. Review: https://github.com/synchronic1/AIPSTER/pull/14#discussion_r4405943472
local_patches.upstream_status: Not submitted upstream; upstream commit above remains unpatched.

local_patches.reason: Integration: connect the public worker's opt-in fabric bridge to the deployed Ganglion node protocol. Exact resident-model binding (no cold start, switch or fallback), resident-only capacity advertisement, result job-id binding, permanent handshake/close rejection handling, narrow attach quarantine, sanitized failure logging and snapshot host-identity fallbacks.
local_patches.upstream_status: Not submitted upstream; upstream commit above remains unpatched.
